feeds.title: Revolution Mountain Bike Magazine
feeds.description: Published quarterly Revolution is a magazine of pure quality in production - from our editorial content right through to the stunning high-stock paper that we are printed on. Revolution stands apart from other MTB magazines on the shelf. Inside each issue you will find a balanced yet dynamic mix of highly creative editorial content, focused on the true all-mountain side of riding.

feeds.title: St Helens Mountain Bike Trails
feeds.description: The St Helens Mountain Bike Trails are some of the most scenic trails in the world - where else can you ride Mountains to the Sea, ending your ride in one of the most beautiful beaches in the world, the Bay of Fires. Follow their blog to get trail information, event news, travel tips, race updates, product information and more.

feeds.title: Australian Geographic » Mountain Bike
feeds.description: Australian Geographic's mountain bike blog shares information about bikes, product reviews trail detail, the latest news and updates, and many more useful things. Australian Geographic captures the essence and spirit of Australia through its meticulously crafted and beautifully presented stories and photography in print and online.

feeds.title: Mountain Journal » Mountain Biking
feeds.description: The Mountain Journal is an online publication based in Australia that provides news, information, and stories about mountain culture, the environment, and outdoor recreation. The blog also covers Mountian biking and provides information about mountain biking trails, the latest events, past & upcoming races, personal adventure stories, and more.

feeds.title: Mountain Bike Coaching Brisbane Blog
feeds.description: The Mountain Bike Coaching Brisbane Blog covers topics such as tips to maintain cycles, product reviews, equipment descriptions, bike wraps details, myths and more. Mountain Bike Coaching Brisbane offers both skills and fitness training through AusCycling qualified mountain bike coaches. Established in 2014, their coaching team holds experience with juniors of all ages through to adults. They cater to all abilities, also hosting many courses for recreational beginners through to sessions to fine tune skills and abilities of elite racers.

feeds.title: MTB Direct Au News
feeds.description: MTB Direct is committed to providing the Australian MTB community with great value products across a wide variety of parts, clothing, and accessories. Get more value for every ride. Read their MTB Direct Au Blog for articles on mountain biking, summer riding tips, race day details, personal stories, feature stories, trail details, and more related information.

feeds.title: Flow Mountain Bike
feeds.description: Flow Mountain Bike is the first and last name in mountain biking throughout Australia and New Zealand. Rider owned and run, Flow Mountain Bike is the ultimate resource to keep you informed and inspired. Head to Flow Mountain Bike blog for all the latest mountain bike news, new products, race coverage and more. We keep you informed through video bike reviews and product tests, maintenance advice, riding tips and skills, interviews and tonnes of great web-only features. Enjoy- feel the Flow!

feeds.title: Australian Mountain Bike Magazine
feeds.description: Australian Mountain Bike magazine blog is Australia's oldest and most respected mountain bike magazine, inspiring and informing riders around the country in print and online. We inform and inspire Australian mountain bikers about everything that makes our sport what it is.

feeds.title: rideTECHNICS Blog
feeds.description: rideTECHNICS has been providing the highest level of cycling and MTB skills coaching for riders of all levels and various disciplines for over 25 years. Our highly experienced and accredited coaches guarantee results through the use of proven methods and ongoing support. Read our blog and learn more about ride details, product reviews, race events, games, training program details and more.
